A '''species''' of small, [[Color/Legends|brown]] furred creatures were native to the [[Forest/Legends|Forest]] [[Moon/Legends|Moon]] [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. After her parents were rescued from the [[Gorax/Legends|Gorax]], [[Cindel Towani]] held one creature of this [[Species/Legends|species]] in the [[Warrick family/Legends|Warrick]] family hut.<ref name="CoC" />

==Behind the scenes==
This species first appeared in the [[1984]] television movie ''[[Caravan of Courage: An Ewok Adventure]]''.<ref name="CoC" /> ''Caravan of Courage'' contained many real animals, including [[Wikipedia:Hamster|hamsters]] who were used to portray this creature.<ref name="Blog">{{SW|url=news/drawing-from-the-present-familiar-creatures-in-a-galaxy-far-far-away|text=Drawing from the Present: Familiar Creatures in a Galaxy Far, Far Away|int=Back from the Drawing Board|nolive=1}}</ref> Although the species has not received an in-universe name, [[hamster]]s were mentioned by name in the non-canon special ''[[Phineas and Ferb: Star Wars]]''.<ref name="PaF">''[[Phineas and Ferb: Star Wars]]''</ref>

In [[Back from the Drawing Board|''Drawing from the Present: Familiar Creatures in a Galaxy Far, Far Away'']], a [[2013]] article written for the [[Star Wars Blog]] by [[Tim Veekhoven]] and [[Mark Newbold]], hamsters were mentioned among the many real-world animals that appeared in the ''[[Star Wars]]'' live-action movies.<ref name="Blog" />
